notes: Ministry of Transport parking application, so it sits beside Pango and Cellopark. Pin and version from the build installed from Play (1.1.1, versionCode 113), signed with Play App Signing (CN=Android, O=Google Inc.). It is an OutSystems shell: the screens are a web application served from transportation.outsystems.app and shown in a WebView, which is why the policy can be an allow list of one host.
